options.content:
## Engineering evidence

| Executable surface | Line coverage |
|---|---:|
| Flutter client | **63.9%** |
| Pi Voice Service | **36.4%** |
| Gondolin workspace adapter | **53.4%** |
| Combined Pi agent JavaScript | **40.3%** |

Build evidence snapshot · 2026-10-16. Other surfaces have test evidence but no consolidated executable-line report.

## How to read this dashboard

**C2 fill = telemetry activity:** 🔴 missing or stale for 2 minutes · ⚪ idle · 🔵 low · 🟦 medium · 🟢 high. Activity is volume, not health.

**C2 border = evidence:** 🟢 strong · 🟠 partial · 🔵 observed · 🔴 weak. All other views use neutral gray backgrounds so the live container trace remains the sole highlight.

Architecture and evidence remain source-controlled; operations remain live in Grafana. Use the dashboard links for RED product signals and USE resource signals.
